title: ev_mod_set check
description: A test for core-a4mk2 0.7's ev_mod_set on the Analog Four MKII: it records every modulation setup edit core reports (VELOCITY, MOD WHEEL, PITCH BEND, BREATH, AFTERTOUCH and PERF destinations and depths) in ms_check (modset.c); while armed (MS TEST in SETTINGS) it takes every depth change of slot 4 (knob J).
